newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Excelsior-Henderson gets buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Excelsior-Henderson gets buy.

text.p: Miller, Johnson & Kuehn said Monday it began cover of Excelsior-Henderson Motorcycle Manufacturing Co with a buy rating for speculative, growth investors.

-- The market is large and thriving, demographic trends are favorable, dealer interest is terrific, an experienced management team is in place, sufficient capital has been raised, and strong consumer demand exists for its planned motorcycle, said Miller, Johnson in a report.
-- Shares of Excelsior-Henderson were trading off 1/8 to 7-1/8.
